notes: Fixes 0.4.0 stalling DungeonHelper and covering its toolbar. Two mistakes: the hub's panel was sized to hold the entire interface, so it sat on top of DungeonHelper's own bar, and drawing the plugin list asked every hosted plugin for its icon — which quietly built each one's whole window while DungeonHelper was still starting up. The DungeonHelper panel is small again with an 'Open Plugin Hub' button, and opening the hub costs nothing until you press it. The hub now opens as a proper overlay: a borderless window that floats above the game, centred on your client, dragged by its title bar, resizable from any edge, and kept out of the taskbar. Plugin icons fill into the list a moment after it opens rather than all at once, so it appears instantly however many plugins you have.
